title: Check the status of Terms
content_data:
Use this endpoint to check the status of an agreement. If the agreement has been signed, you can get the agreement using [/term/get/](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737191909315585). ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Change{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path|/v1.2/term/check/|/v1.3/term/check/| |Request parameter data type|`advertiser_id`: number|`advertiser_id`: string| ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/term/check/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |term_type {Required}|string|Type of agreement. Enum values: `LeadAds`. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --get -H "Access-Token:xxx" \ --data-urlencode "advertiser_id=< ADVERTISER_ID >" \ --data-urlencode "term_type=< TERM_TYPE >" \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/term/check/ (/code) ``` ## Response ```xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number|Return code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string|Return messages. For details, see [Appendix-Return information](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |data |object|Returned data. | #|confirmed |boolean|Signing status of the agreement. `True` means "Signed successfully ",
`False` means "Not signed". | |request_id |string|The log id of a request, which uniquely identifies the request.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": { "confirmed": true }, "request_id": "2020022414253401011023224213472" } (/code); ```
